context: Radial hierarchical edge bundle showing cross-module dependencies among 6 software modules (core, render, data, network, auth, storage), ~100 edges, with collapse/expand on internal nodes and an adjustable bundle tension slider.
first_impression: The default beta of 0.30 produces near-straight edges that all cross through the center, turning the interior into an undifferentiated tangle that obscures any structure.
what_works: The 6-color TOL palette maps cleanly to modules with perceptually distinct hues, and the module labels at the periphery anchor each cluster so the outer ring is easy to read; hover-based edge highlighting and collapse/expand are sound design choices for managing density interactively (though not assessable from a static screenshot).
what_doesnt: At the default low beta the bundling provides almost no routing benefit — edges fan straight to center-crossing paths rather than following the hierarchy, making it impossible to trace or count connections without hovering; the interior is a dense gray hairball that defeats the core purpose of edge bundling.
